title: Smoked Mackerel and Shallot Rillettes
blurb: Flaked smoked mackerel mixed with cream cheese, caramelised shallots and fresh herbs makes a rich spread for toasted bread, served with a simple carrot and spinach salad.
steps: Peel and finely slice the shallots, then cook them gently in the olive oil in a small pan over low heat for about 15 minutes until soft and golden, stirring occasionally.
While the shallots cook, remove the skin from the mackerel fillets and flake the flesh into a mixing bowl, discarding any bones.
Peel the carrot and cut it into thin ribbons with a vegetable peeler, then toss with the baby spinach and set aside.
When the shallots are done, let them cool for a few minutes, then add them to the mackerel along with the cream cheese, chopped chives, lemon juice and black pepper.
Mix everything together with a fork, breaking up the mackerel and cream cheese to create a rough, spreadable texture.
Toast the bread, then serve the rillettes spread on the warm toast with the carrot and spinach salad on the side.
